summary: Complete documentation for the E-Internship Dishub Next.js 14 frontend infrastructure. Covers 39 files including 15 reusable components (UI, charts, forms), 3 lib modules (axios, auth, utils), TypeScript types (30+ interfaces), middleware route protection, 4 route group layouts, Tailwind design system, and 11 page placeholders. Includes component usage examples and setup instructions.
